name: BG National 13–14 & 15–16 · second exercise
description: Elements over 2.1 count as 2.1. To qualify for the British Championships (no penalty otherwise): 13–14 men difficulty 8.3 and total 76.0, women 7.8 and 75.0; 15–16 men 10.0 and 81.0, women 9.0 and 80.0.
source: British Gymnastics 2026 Technical Requirements, Trampoline National Pathway (v1, August 2025)
